task: Ensure explicit Margo module builds run Java semantic validation before emitting interfaces and Rust.
observation: The explicit-module branch of ProjectBuilder parsed and rewrote modules, then emitted interfaces/Rust without invoking CheckedProgram. A bounded invalid provider/consumer project therefore had no compiler semantic gate before backend generation. The build now constructs a checker view containing the current module and transitive local imports and runs CheckedProgram before emission. Standard declarations repeated in parsed modules are deduplicated by rewritten declaration identity.
impact: An actual ProjectBuilder.build regression with a local provider import and a return type mismatch now fails with a semantic diagnostic before native compilation. Modules with external imports are still skipped because external ABI declarations are not yet materialized into this checker view; overall source-free project checking remains open.

resolution.summary: The focused ProjectBuilder metadata test and all ten Java unit-test classes pass. The invalid project exits at TYPE_MISMATCH before rustc. External source-free import checking remains unimplemented.
